structure:Dataflow.common:Name: B13 Language Spoken at Home by Sex (LGA)
structure:Dataflow.common:Description: Dataset: ABS_CENSUS2011_B13_LGA. LGA2011 based data for Language spoken at home by Sex, Basic Community Profile Table B13, for 2011 Census. Unit of measure: Count of all persons on Census night, based on place of usual residence. Excludes Overseas Visitors. Geographic coverage: ASGS2011 LGA2016. Catalogue number: 2916.0

structure:Categorisation.common:Name: B13 Language Spoken at Home by Sex (LGA) Categorisation

common:Annotation.common:AnnotationText: Comprises' Indo-Aryan, nfd', 'Gujarati', 'Konkani', 'Marathi', 'Nepali', 'Sindhi', 'Assamese', 'Dhivehi', 'Kashmiri', 'Oriya', 'Fijian Hindustani' and 'Indo-Aryan, nec'.

structure:Code.common:Name: Minutely
structure:Code.common:Description: While N denotes "minutely", usually, there may be no observations every minute (for several series the frequency is usually "irregular" within a day/days). And though observations may be sparse (not collected or disseminated every minute), missing values do not need to be given for the minutes when no observations exist: in any case the time stamp determines when an observation is observed.

structure:Code.common:Name: Daily or businessweek
structure:Code.common:Description: Similar to "daily", however there are no observations for Saturdays and Sundays (so, neither "missing values" nor "numeric values" should be provided for Saturday and Sunday). This treatment ("business") is one way to deal with such cases, but it is not the only option. Such a time series could alternatively be considered daily ("D"), thus, with missing values in the weekend.

common:Annotation.common:AnnotationText: Records responses to the Census question 'Does the person speak a language other than English at home?', and is coded using the Australian Standard Classification of Languages (ASCL), 2016 (cat. no. 1267.0). This question allows for one answer only and therefore the number of responses shown in the category '1201 English' is not all persons who speak English, but specifically persons who speak only English at home.
If sex is not stated it is imputed.
